description.value: Desserts Artisanaux is an authentic Cantonese dessert cafe on the Kingsway corridor in East Vancouver, specializing in handcrafted sweets made from traditional recipes — including double skin steamed milk pudding, mochi, sago soups, and seasonal specialties like pumpkin paste. The shop emphasizes 'not too sweet' flavours and slow, intentional preparation, and offers takeout with outdoor seating available.
